note: Implementation comparison between the two DeepCrack side-fusion orders at 50 epochs. Parameter counts are tensor-for-tensor identical, but the physical batch and its accumulation differ, and each side loss is divided by the physical batch before the optimizer rescales the accumulated step. Accuracy and timing differences therefore do not isolate fusion order. One seed per cell cannot establish equivalence either.
loss_normalization: Mean-reduced BCE is additionally divided by physical batch size: 8 for fast-fuse, 2 for official-fuse, before optimizer accumulation rescales by the accumulation count (4).
micro_batch_official_fuse: 2 x 4 accumulation (batch 8 fails with CUDA error)
